content.text: Phase 2 is done. I'll typecheck and lint, then commit, push and tag it `compaction-v2`.

input.command:
cd "C:/Users/shrey/desktop/Elemental_harness" && npx tsc -b packages/compaction/compaction-basic && npx tsx scripts/run-oxlint.ts packages/compaction/compaction-basic && echo CHECKS-OK && git add -A && git commit -q -F - <<'EOF'

git log -1 --oneline && git push -q -u origin compaction-phase2 2>&1 | tail -2; git tag -a compaction-v2 -m "Phase 2: checkpoint keeps user messages, security constraints, merge rules" && git push -q origin refs/tags/compaction-v2 2>&1 | tail -2; git status --short | head
